GETs.response: pointBase.krw exchange conversion; used only if currencyUnit USD
GETs.warning: Not an invoice, tax or rounding rule.

query.owner: resolved in memory from authenticated account

GETs.warning: Actual workload aggregate daily spending; GPU usage unit not established solely by field name. Never dump account identity or provider internal pricing.

matching: Use match_gpu_pricing: gpuName+gpuExt+ppIndex+gpuCount+vram+cpu+memory+disk+tier. Skip absent dimensions only as CLI backwardcompat; uniqueness is required for a reliable actualquote.
units: The package explicitly models currencyUnit KRW/USD. skills source says gpu list hourly cash prices, 1P=1KRW; do not use this alone to infer VAT-inclusive cash replenishment, rounding, network or selected-node contract.
selectedNodeCaveat: nodes[] is passthrough and no precise node-entry schema is declared in GpuPricing; inspect keys only with redacted field allowlists if needed.
